companies.name: OpenAI
companies.role: ChatGPT Work's cloud browser opens sites, clicks and fills forms for paid users; it replaced ChatGPT agent in August 2026.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.role: Claude in Chrome reads pages and clicks, types and fills forms in the user's own browser on paid plans.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.role: Comet is a free AI browser whose assistant acts on web pages for the user.

companies.name: Google
companies.role: Gemini connected apps act across Android and Google apps, Chrome auto browse acts on sites (US and India), and AI Mode phones businesses (US).

companies.name: Amazon
companies.role: Alexa+ orders, books and controls smart homes through voice and partner services.

companies.name: Apple
companies.role: Siri AI uses personal context and App Intents to act in apps like Messages and WhatsApp, in beta and outside the EU.

repos.name: Browser Use
repos.role: Python library that lets a language model drive a real browser: open pages, click, type and fill forms.

repos.name: Playwright MCP
repos.role: MCP server that gives any agent a Playwright browser it can navigate, click and type in.

repos.name: Stagehand
repos.role: Browser automation SDK where an agent acts on web pages from plain-English steps like "click the sign-in button".

repos.name: Skyvern
repos.role: Agent that uses vision and a language model to fill forms and run tasks on websites it has never seen before.

repos.name: OpenHands
repos.role: Open agent platform that writes code, runs commands and browses the web to finish a task on its own.

repos.name: UI-TARS Desktop and Agent TARS
repos.role: Desktop and browser agent that looks at the screen and clicks and types to use apps and websites for you.

repos.name: Agent S
repos.role: Framework for agents that use a computer like a person does, moving the mouse and typing across apps.

repos.name: Mobilerun (formerly DroidRun)
repos.role: Framework that lets an agent control an Android or iOS phone: open apps, tap, type and finish tasks.

repos.name: Pipecat
repos.role: Python framework for real-time voice agents that can place and answer phone calls and hold a conversation.

repos.name: LiveKit Agents
repos.role: Framework for voice agents that talk in real time, including over regular phone lines (SIP) to call a business.

repos.name: n8n
repos.role: Workflow automation tool where an AI agent can take real actions in hundreds of apps, like sending email or messages.

repos.name: Dify
repos.role: Platform to build AI assistants and agents that call tools and APIs to act in other apps.

repos.name: LangChain
repos.role: Python framework to build agents that call tools and APIs to take actions for a user.

repos.name: LangGraph
repos.role: Library to run long, multi-step agents with memory and human approval steps before they act.

repos.name: CrewAI
repos.role: Framework where a team of agents shares a task and uses tools to get it done.

repos.name: AutoGen
repos.role: Microsoft framework for agents that talk to each other and use tools to finish tasks.

repos.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
repos.role: Small Python SDK to build agents that call tools, hand off to other agents and act for a user.

repos.name: MCP Python SDK
repos.role: Official Python SDK for the Model Context Protocol, the open standard that connects agents to apps and tools.

repos.name: MCP TypeScript SDK
repos.role: Official TypeScript SDK for the Model Context Protocol, the open standard that connects agents to apps and tools.
